item.title: Show HN: Turtle – Web Browser written from scratch for 2 years
item.summary: A few weeks ago I posted my solo browser projects and since I have received lots of messages asking the download link. I was a bit reluctant to release it since it's not at a stable level yet. However I finally decided to just put it out there as a pre-alpha since so many emails I have received. So now you can grab this pre-alpha from https://code.intellios.ai/cwbrowser/ Note: Expect bugs, missing features, and crashes. Plenty of the web will render imperfectly or not at all. This is an early look, not a daily driver. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49340294 Points: 2 # Comments: 1
